description: This file defines the ReadOnlyHelperDAO class, which implements a read-only data access object for entities in the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides methods for retrieving entity data without allowing modifications, emphasizing its read-only nature.

classes.name: ReadOnlyHelperDAO
classes.description: A DAO class providing read-only access to entity data, implementing the GenericHelper interface, and ensuring no modifications are performed on the database.

methods.name: getHelperName
methods.description: Returns the full name of the helper.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Attempt to create a new entity; always returns null as operation is read-only.

methods.name: findByPrimaryKey
methods.description: Retrieves a GenericValue entity by its primary key.

methods.name: findByPrimaryKeyPartial
methods.description: Retrieves a partial GenericValue entity by primary key, returning only specified fields.

methods.name: findAllByPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Retrieves multiple entities by a list of primary keys.

methods.name: removeByPrimaryKey
methods.description: Attempt to remove an entity by primary key; operation is a no-op, returns 0.

methods.name: findListIteratorByCondition
methods.description: Finds entities matching specified conditions, returning an iterator.

methods.name: findByMultiRelation
methods.description: Finds related entities through multiple relations.

methods.name: removeByCondition
methods.description: Attempt to remove entities by condition; always returns 0.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Attempt to store (update) an entity; operation is a no-op, returns 0.

methods.name: storeByCondition
methods.description: Attempt to store entities by condition; operation is a no-op, returns 0.

methods.name: checkDataSource
methods.description: Checks the data source for entity definitions, with no modifications in read-only mode.
